project_type: Next.js 14 App Router web app (TypeScript) - QuantFeed, an AI economic news intelligence dashboard deployed on Vercel serverless
build_system: npm / bun. Scripts in package.json: dev=next dev, build=next build, start=next start, lint=next lint. bun.lock present; either npm or bun works.
test_framework: None. No test runner or test files exist in the repo. Verification is via build + lint + manual dev-server curl checks.
build_command: npm run build (or bun run build). Must complete with no type errors.
test_command: No unit tests exist. Verification = 'npm run lint' passes AND 'npm run build' passes AND a live-fetch smoke test: start 'npm run dev', then curl 'http://localhost:3000/api/news' and confirm returned articles have publishedAt within the last ~2 days and dataSource is 'live'.
verification_instructions: 1) Run 'npm run lint' - must pass. 2) Run 'npm run build' - must pass with no TS/type errors. 3) Run 'npm run dev' in background, wait ~5s, then 'curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/news | head -c 2000' and confirm dataSource=='live' and the newest article publishedAt is within ~2 days of the current date. Also curl /api/graph and /api/analysis to confirm they return live/non-empty data. Kill the dev server after.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. The data/ directory only has .gitkeep (bundled seed data mechanism, currently empty). No snapshot tests.
setup_instructions: npm install (or bun install). Copy .env.example to .env.local if using optional API keys (GNEWS_API_KEY, NEWSDATA_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET) - all optional; the app must work with NO keys using RSS + Google News RSS.
environment_constraints: Network mode is OPEN_INTERNET - can fetch any RSS/API and install packages. Node v22, npm and bun available. TARGET RUNTIME is Vercel serverless: the /tmp filesystem is EPHEMERAL and resets on cold starts, so file-based persistence in lib/news/store.ts CANNOT be relied on for freshness. Google News RSS (news.google.com/rss/search?q=...&when:1d) was tested from this environment and returns current-dated items reliably.
contribution_requirements: Commit style: conventional commits (feat:, fix:, chore:). All work stays on branch feat/design-and-live-data (already checked out). Do NOT push or open PRs. README documents the app structure but has no hard test gate beyond build/lint.
key_patterns: API routes are Next.js Route Handlers under app/api/*/route.ts, all 'export const dynamic = force-dynamic'. Data flow: RSS/API fetch in lib/news/fetcher.ts + lib/news/api-fetcher.ts -> optional persist in lib/news/store.ts (/tmp) -> scored in app/api/news/route.ts via lib/freshness/recency-scorer.ts + lib/freshness/topic-tracker.ts -> served to client hooks in lib/hooks/useApiData.ts (useNews/useGraphData/useAnalysis/usePredictions). UI is client components using framer-motion + Tailwind utility classes; shared 'glass-premium' component classes live in app/globals.css; palette tokens in tailwind.config.js (dark.900-600, primary indigo, accent colors). DataSourceBadge shows live/cached/sample. mock-data.ts holds fallback sample articles with HARDCODED 2024-12 dates (stale).
